gen-dafont-joystix-gf-montagu-slab: Montagu Slab is a text serif with robust downstrokes, slender turns and a generous x-height that holds up on screen. Joystix earns its keep big and short, its widely tracked arcade letters doing the shouting.
gen-dafont-joystix-gf-ovo: Joystix is all bold arcade attitude, with widely tracked letters and stems barely heavier than their arms. Ovo, a text serif, does the quieter work, with thins close to its thicks and a tall middle band.
gen-dafont-junegull-gf-esteban: Retro, friendly, and drawn with flat linework. Esteban runs its lowercase large beside its capitals, so a modest size suits it, while Junegull keeps crossbars as fat as their stems.
gen-dafont-junegull-gf-faustina: Junegull draws flat, single-weight lines with a retro, friendly grin. Faustina brings moderate contrast, gracefully thinning bowls and an open-jawed c, so paragraphs glide along with a steady, authoritative ease.
gen-dafont-junegull-gf-halant: Tall, traditional and faintly modulated, the text here has outward-pointing terminals and a towering x-height. Halant handles the reading with open letters, while Junegull does its best work in closed, retro shapes.
gen-dafont-junegull-gf-hedvig-letters-se: Hedvig Letters Serif offers open-ended curves, a tall sturdy lowercase and medium contrast in true classic serif fashion. And Junegull brings the closed, friendly retro shapes that stand out in a heading.
gen-dafont-junegull-gf-marcellus-sc: Marcellus SC is a text serif with gentle stroke modulation and terminals pulled well back, giving open, dignified letters. Junegull holds closed, constant-width lines; Marcellus SC does the literary work.
gen-dafont-junegull-gf-montagu-slab: A wire-bent look runs through every word of Junegull, retro and friendly with closed letters. Montagu Slab is a text serif, moderate in thick-thin ratio and open in its letters, giving that closed look its sharpest foil.
gen-dafont-junegull-gf-ovo: Friendly is the first word for Junegull, whose strokes skim along without ever changing weight. And Ovo, a serif with softly varied thickness, gives that lightness a tall, grounded footing on the page.
gen-dafont-lemon-milk-gf-fauna-one: Fauna One has a low, literary feel, classic serif style with shallow ascenders and a generous entry into the e. Lemon Milk shouts in wide, rounded letters, but paragraphs in Fauna One move at a dignified, unhurried pace.
